title: RCA trigger policy
description: Thresholds at which a confirmed downtime occurrence or a repeated functional failure recommends or creates an RCA case. Spec RCA01 (versioned trigger conditions on confirmed duration, quantity, approved impact and repeated failure; open events trigger once the threshold is exceeded with a provisional marker; replays never duplicate cases), RCA02 (automation creates a recommendation or a case per policy, never a proven root cause), KPI07 (functional failure taxonomy). Decision D13. Consumed by sub-phase 3.9 (`RcaTriggerService`); the per-rule thresholds of 3.8 `rules(kind=rca_trigger_hint)` default to these values.

durationThresholdSeconds.description: Confirmed (or elapsed, for open occurrences - provisional) unplanned downtime duration at or above which the trigger fires (RCA01). 0 disables the duration trigger.

costThreshold.description: Approved valued impact (in `valuation_basis.currency`, default basis) at or above which the trigger fires on `PeriodApproved`. Null disables the cost trigger - the default until a currency and valuation policy are approved (D08).

repeatCount.description: Number of eligible functional failures (D13 taxonomy: FailureWO event or unplanned stop with failure code) on the same asset within repeatWindowDays that fires the repeated-failure trigger.

repeatWindowDays.description: Rolling window, in local operational days, for repeatCount.

autoCreate.description: `recommend`: emit `RCARecommended` and show a badge; a person creates or links the case. `create`: open the case automatically with its evidence package (RCA02). Advisory events (IOW/APM) can only ever recommend (T42).
